rationale: Retain and strengthen. PMID 24554705 gives direct N. crassa experimental support (IDA/IMP) for H3K56 acetyltransferase activity; the current IBA understates the evidence. PMID 42832562 does not refute the activity, only its sufficiency for PRC2 silencing.
Retain as the correct parent. It is the appropriate term if a curator wants a site-agnostic MF that accommodates an unidentified second site.
Retain; redundant with GO:0010484 but harmless.
Unsupported in N. crassa. The yeast route to H3K9ac is Vps75-dependent (PMID 18458063) and NAF-2 is dispensable for the N. crassa phenotype (PMID 42832562). No N. crassa H3K9ac measurement exists.
Same reasoning as GO:0043992. Tempting because the phenotype is an H3K27me3 defect, but H3K27ac was never assayed and the chaperone route is excluded.
No evidence in any fungus linking RTT109 H3K14ac to PRC2 silencing; never assayed in N. crassa.

Strongest new-term lead. PMID 42832562 shows RTT109 is required for the structure and function of PRC2-methylated chromatin, with catalytic-dead alleles failing to rescue. Evidence code IMP. Consider whether 'maintenance' rather than 'formation' is the better fit, since the paper frames the role as epigenetic maintenance over mitoses.
